messages.subject: Matlab Stan
parts:
Hi,

I am having trouble running a simple eight schools example on Matlab Stan. I followed the installation instructions on Github -- https://github.com/brian-lau/MatlabStan/wiki/Getting-Started.  I am running the following code:




schools_dat = struct('J',8,...

                     'y',[28 8 -3 7 -1 1 18 12],...

                     'sigma',[15 10 16 11 9 11 10 18]);

 

fit1 = stan('file','eight_schools.stan','data',schools_dat,'iter',1000,'chains',4);

 





I get the following error:

Error using StanModel/set.file (line 329)
File does not exist

Error in StanModel/set (line 273)
               self.file = p.Results.file;

Error in StanModel/sampling (line 709)
         self.set(varargin{:});

Error in stan (line 137)
   fit = model.sampling(p.Unmatched);

Error in stantest (line 7)
fit1 = stan('file','eight_schools.stan','data',schools_dat,'iter',1000,'chains',4);
 






I am trying to run it on OS X Yosemite Version 10.10.3. Please help!!



Jalaj

messages.author: 9b28b631db3b0ea2
messages.subject: Re: Matlab Stan
parts:
Hi

Does it work using 

fit = stan('model_code',schools_code,'data',schools_dat);

after setting schools_code exactly as the example. 

schools_code = {
'data {'
'    int<lower=0> J; // number of schools '
'    real y[J]; // estimated treatment effects'
'    real<lower=0> sigma[J]; // s.e. of effect estimates '
'}'
'parameters {'
'    real mu; '
'    real<lower=0> tau;'
'    real eta[J];'
'}'
'transformed parameters {'
'    real theta[J];'
'    for (j in 1:J)'
'    theta[j] <- mu + tau * eta[j];'
'}'
'model {'
'    eta ~ normal(0, 1);'
'    y ~ normal(theta, sigma);'
'}'
};


If so, then you may need to give the full path to the 'eight_schools.stan' file.
